Gloamtide · Level 1 rebuild · Concept round 7

The Wreck Shore

The way out of the bay: when the stand on the beach is won, a road cut into the basalt climbs the cliff in switchbacks to a ruined gatehouse, with the keep of an old fortress looming above it. Where whole bundles of columns sweep out over the beach, they curve together, as in your painting.

Rendered in three.js from the level kit. Only drizzle and a grade are added on top. The cliffs, falls, stacks, wreckage, birds, sea and ground are all generated in code, so each can still be reshaped.

New this round

  • The curved column bundles from your painting. Whole bundles sweep out over the beach together without coming apart.
  • The road out: a ramp from the beach, four switchback legs cut into the cliff, a turret at each hairpin, and a gatehouse at the top.
  • A ruined fortress on the clifftop: walls along the rim, towers, and a gothic keep with a dome and spires that you can see from the beach and the sea.
  • The foam frays into wisps and lace instead of ending on hard edges.

Still rough

  • Up close, the gatehouse stone is still a little regular, and the lit windows read flat.
  • Through the gate you see open sky and sea for now. The next level will be there.
  • The playable level is still the old beach. Next: rebuild it on this scene, with the road opening when the stand is won and the gate leading on to the next level.
